role: Judge gate: allocate <=3 pre-registered backtest specs over recon-verified data only; assess Track A post-verification.
multiple_comparison_policy: Exactly 3 specs registered in this funnel, each with ONE gating primary test. Family alpha = 0.05 one-sided, Bonferroni across 3 specs => per-spec alpha = 0.0167 one-sided. Fixed numeric bars derived from that alpha and frozen NOW, before any test data is read: all Wilson/normal interval bounds use z = 2.128 (98.33% one-sided); all day-clustered t-stat gates use a fixed conservative bar t >= 2.25 with a minimum of 40 clusters (t_crit at alpha=0.0167 is <=2.23 for df>=30, so 2.25 dominates it; no df haggling later). These bars apply to every spec below; no spec may add gating subtests without re-registering the family.
tracka_assessment: UPHELD by adversarial verification (minor findings only: harness fidelity, lock-rule provenance at bd90504, and hourly-baseline reproduction all independently confirmed). Fit to publish AS-IS on the two pre-registered bars (coverage 64.2%, Wilson LB 52.2% > 40.9% baseline; false-lock 0/344): yes. Two required framing edits before publication, neither blocking: (1) the non-gating EV of -19.41c/ct must be labeled proxy-dominated -- tracka_results.json shows live_spreads_c.chicago = 20.0c, i.e. every priced fire carries a +10c half-spread penalty from a SINGLE run-time book snapshot, 50-100x the 0.2c spread the prior study probed for the same city; the sign of that number is therefore not trustworthy in either direction, and it additionally rests on the item-2b reweighting assumption (86.1% entry false rate applied as an out-of-sample base rate) rather than direct per-fire accounting. (2) Keep the 2026-02-09..02-22 IEM asos1min archive-gap disclosure prominent (backtest-feed limitation, not a live-feed limitation). Deployment picture: the coverage blocker from pmkt_final_verdict.md IS lifted for Chicago -- that is a real state change -- but Track A does NOT green-light a Polymarket harness. The single gating open question for the whole Polymarket sleeve is now direct, loss-inclusive EV at MEASURED executable asks, which recon has just made answerable (pmxt.dev order-book archive, verified live with schema + sample extraction, 2026-04-13 onward). That is spec S1. Nothing in Track A changes Kalshi operations.

selected: S1 pmkt_measured_ask_ev: decisive for the sleeve; counterparty-error mechanism already directly measured (pmkt_gap_study decaying gap, n=15 mean 0.44 at lock); all four feeds + the order-book archive recon-verified; independent value even as a kill.

S2 tokyo_10min_go: extends Track A along GROUNDING GO-path #2 with the ONLY strongly-preferred-tier (10-min) international feed recon found; Tokyo is whitelist basis-sound; JMA feed verified at 144 rows/day to 365d depth.

S3 forecastex_lock_ev: only US-legal, directly deployable candidate; product is the NATIVE uncapped-threshold shape (monotonic running max/min) that the proven Kalshi mechanism runs on -- not the 93%-wrong bracket shape; venue's own free millisecond trade tape + settlement files recon-verified; flat-fee economics is the known risk and is priced into the bars.
rejected: London/Paris 30-min rerun: MARGINAL tier only (30-min); pmkt_final_verdict measured 4.5%/20.8% hourly coverage -- doubling cadence cannot plausibly clear a >=50% bar given the geometric dead-zone mechanism; their 30-min feeds are instead consumed inside S1 for entry timing. Not worth one of 3 Bonferroni slots.
Sao Paulo: feed hunt DEAD (strictly hourly). No spec possible.
Mexico City: no recon-verified sub-hourly feed (never hunted). Auto-invalid under the unverified-feed rule; excluded from S1's universe too.
Polymarket AQI family: real book observed once but recurrence unverified, currently zero live events -- fails backtestability-now.
Mt. Washington wind: monthly cadence, fast-feed side unverified -- fails cadence and verified-feed bars.
Polymarket US (QCX): confirmed no weather listings and gated API -- nothing to test.

Precipitation/earthquake/flu/macro families: graveyard transfers, no structural reason the kill does not transfer (recon itself checked for material differences and found only liquidity differences, not mechanism differences).
On-chain venue sweep: DEAD, nothing listed.

specs.title: Polymarket whitelist EV at MEASURED asks (pmxt.dev order-book archive)
specs.hypothesis: The deployed bracket-entry signal (item-2b construction from pmkt_final_verdict.py: first moment the glitch-filtered, sustain-3, margin-cleared running extreme falls inside a rung's margin-adjusted qualifying band), bought at the MEASURED best ask and held to settlement, has fee-inclusive EV whose sign can be established directly -- replacing both the last-trade+half-live-spread proxy and the item-2b reweighting with per-fire loss-inclusive accounting. Either sign is decisive: PASS revives the sleeve, a bounded-negative kills it cleanly.
specs.data_plan: Cities/feeds (ALL recon-verified): Chicago KORD via IEM asos1min (verified in Track A; note archive gap 2026-02-09..22 is outside this window); Tokyo RJTT via JMA 10-min AMeDAS prec_no=44&block_no=0371 (verified 144 rows/day, 365d depth); London EGLC and Paris LFPB via IEM asos.py with report_type=3&report_type=4 (verified 48 rows/day). Mexico City and Sao Paulo EXCLUDED (no verified sub-hourly feed). Markets/outcomes: gamma-api.polymarket.com event ladders + resolved brackets (same harness as pmkt_final_verdict.py/tracka_chicago_1min.py, reused verbatim). Prices: pmxt.dev hourly parquet order-book archive (https://r2v2.pmxt.dev/polymarket_orderbook_YYYY-MM-DDTHH.parquet), verified live by recon with schema dump + filtered extraction of 2 known asset_ids; read via pyarrow+fsspec HTTP range reads only, filtered by asset_id; mirror every hour-file actually used into venue_expansion/cache/ (third-party continuity caveat). Window: 2026-04-14 through 2026-07-18 (inside pmxt coverage which starts 2026-04-13T19Z), every day, all four cities. Fit/val: NO parameter is tuned (margin/sustain/glitch constants frozen at deployed kwx values, byte-identical shim venue_expansion/kwx_lock_rule.py); therefore the full window is the test set and is read ONCE, after this registration. If any parameter is ever touched, only 2026-06-15..07-18 counts as val and the spec's bars apply to val alone.
specs.entry_rule: Signal: for each usable city-day, every item-2b bracket entry (first time the filtered sustained extreme enters rung r's margin-adjusted band) and every item-2a lock, timestamped by the obs that completes the sustain-3 condition; computed ONLY from the weather feed -- no market-price input, no outcome input. Entry price: the best_ask for that rung's YES token from the first pmxt.dev event at timestamp >= signal time (buy 1 contract at that ask; if no ask event within 60 min of signal, the fire is UNPRICEABLE -- counted and disclosed, never back-filled from earlier or better quotes). No selection among fires: ALL entries in the window are priced (primary population = all item-2b entries; item-2a locks reported as a separate non-gating table). Hold to settlement, no exit rule.
specs.ev_accounting: Net EV per fire (cents/contract) = settlement payout (100 if rung settles YES else 0) - measured best_ask_cents - fee, fee = 100 * 0.05 * p * (1-p) with p = executed ask (Polymarket weather taker-only schedule, verified from live feeSchedule; maker rebates ignored, we are always taker). No spread proxy anywhere. Clustering unit: city-day (each city-day is one cluster); calendar-date clustering also reported as sensitivity. Skip accounting: unpriceable-fire count and thin-book count reported; if >40% of fires are unpriceable the EV estimate is flagged selection-biased (see kill).
specs.min_n: >=120 priced fires across >=40 city-day clusters (expected feasible: Track A alone produced 309 entries/67 Chicago days; ~half fall inside this window, before adding 3 cities). If min_n not reached, verdict is THIN/no-verdict, not a pass.
specs.pass_bar: PASS (sleeve EV-positive) iff city-day-clustered t-stat of mean net EV > 0 satisfies t >= 2.25 (one-sided alpha = 0.0167, Bonferroni 3) AND mean net EV >= +0.5c/contract. Symmetric KILL is pre-registered: if the one-sided 98.33% upper confidence bound (z = 2.128) of mean net EV is < +0.2c/contract, the Polymarket bracket-entry sleeve is declared DEAD at measured prices (graveyard entry). Anything between = INCONCLUSIVE-THIN, reported plainly.
specs.kill_conditions: Kill the spec (no verdict, infrastructure failure) if: pmxt.dev archive is missing/unreadable for >20% of the hour-files the fires need; or >40% of fires are unpriceable within 60 min (selection bias too large to certify either sign); or <120 priced fires / <40 clusters. Kill the SLEEVE if the pre-registered KILL bound above triggers. Deployability flag: this measures the geo-blocked global venue -- measurement only; any deployment is an operator/legal decision (US person context), and Polymarket US lists no weather markets as of 2026-07-23.

specs.title: Tokyo RJTT GO-check on JMA 10-minute AMeDAS (Track A extension, GO-path #2)
specs.hypothesis: Replacing hourly METAR with the recon-verified JMA 10-min AMeDAS feed (Haneda block_no=0371, ~0.3km from RJTT, spot-matched 0.1-0.3C vs RJTT METAR) lifts Tokyo winner-bracket signal coverage decisively above its published hourly baseline (30.8%, n=26, pmkt_final_verdict.md section 4), while the deployed lock rule keeps a Kalshi-grade false-lock rate on this feed -- i.e. the hourly-cadence artifact, not Tokyo's diurnal shape, was the binding constraint, as Track A showed for Chicago.
specs.data_plan: Obs feed: https://www.data.jma.go.jp/stats/etrn/view/10min_a1.php?prec_no=44&block_no=0371&year=Y&month=M&day=D&view= (HTML table parse; recon-verified 144 rows/day at 2d/60d/365d depth; JST timestamps converted to UTC; attribution per Japan Public Data License v1.0). Markets/outcomes: gamma-api Tokyo ladder events + settled brackets, harness reused verbatim from tracka_chicago_1min.py with ONLY fetch_fn swapped and the cadence-appropriate completeness guard re-parameterized for 144/day (>=100 obs/day, <=3h end-gap -- same guard family Track A disclosed). Lock rule: venue_expansion/kwx_lock_rule.py byte-identical (0.5C margin convention identical to pmkt_final_verdict.py's Tokyo handling). Window: 2026-03-15 through 2026-07-18, EVERY day (dense stride=1), ~126 candidate days. Fit/val: nothing tuned; mandatory sanity reproduction BEFORE the primary run: rerun the hourly feed with pmkt_final_verdict.py's exact stride and reproduce its published Tokyo row EXACTLY (usable=26, never_entered=18, coverage=30.8%) -- primary run is invalid without this reproduction, mirroring Track A's sanity A. Cache under venue_expansion/cache/tokyo_10min/, sequential ~1 req/sec.
specs.entry_rule: Identical to Track A: signals are item-2a locks and item-2b bracket entries computed from the obs stream alone (no price, no outcome). Coverage metric: fraction of usable city-days on which the settled winner bracket receives an item-2b entry before the day's obs end. No prices are needed for the gating bars; any EV on Tokyo fires is delegated to S1 (pmxt window overlap) and is non-gating here.
specs.ev_accounting: Not gating in this spec (coverage/false-lock GO-check). Non-gating descriptive EV, if reported, must use S1's measured-ask method only -- the last-trade+half-live-spread proxy is banned here given Track A's 20c spread-probe artifact. Clustering unit for all interval estimates: city-day; coverage and false-lock CIs are Wilson at z = 2.128.
specs.min_n: >=60 usable Tokyo days (of ~126 candidates; JMA feed showed no gaps in recon) and >=200 deployed-rule lock records for bar (b). Below either -> THIN/no-verdict.
specs.pass_bar: GO iff BOTH: (a) pooled winner-bracket coverage >= 50% AND its Wilson lower bound at z = 2.128 (98.33% one-sided, Bonferroni 3) > 30.8% (the published hourly baseline, frozen now); (b) deployed-rule (item 2a) false locks <= 1 wrong with Wilson upper bound at z = 2.128 <= 1.5% -- this doubles as the end-to-end AMeDAS-vs-Wunderground settlement-basis test, since a sensor-offset basis problem manifests exactly as false locks. Fidelity bar (c): backtest_day logic identical to Track A's, only fetch + disclosed completeness guard differ (verifier-checkable by normalized diff).
specs.kill_conditions: Kill if: hourly-baseline reproduction fails to match the published Tokyo row exactly (harness infidelity -- fix or abandon, never proceed); JMA archive develops day-level gaps >25% of candidate days; usable days < 60; or >2 false locks at any point (basis unsound -- Tokyo leaves the whitelist for this feed, spec dead regardless of coverage). Standing caveats to publish with any GO: this archive page is historical-only (in-progress JST day refused) -- live deployment needs JMA's near-real-time AMeDAS JSON channel, NOT verified by recon (non-negotiable #5: latency is part of the signal); and venue deployability = same geo-block flag as S1.

specs.title: ForecastEx daily-temperature lock study: false-lock rate + flat-fee EV on the venue's own trade tape
specs.hypothesis: ForecastEx's Daily Temperature contracts are uncapped one-sided thresholds ('highest temp exceeds X F' / 'lowest below X F') -- the NATIVE monotonic shape of the proven Kalshi mechanical-lock edge, on a CFTC-regulated US-legal venue with real volume (UHLAX 651k pairs/day). Hypothesis: after a margin-cleared sustained lock is confirmed by 1-min ASOS data, the tape still prints fills far enough below settlement value that net EV survives the venue's flat $0.01/side fee (which, unlike Kalshi/Polymarket fees, does NOT shrink as p->1 -- the pre-identified way this dies).
specs.data_plan: Venue data (ALL recon-verified, free, unauthenticated): https://forecastex-public-data.s3.amazonaws.com pairs/pairs_YYYYMMDD.csv (per-fill yes/no price + millisecond pair_time; verified intraday-updated), prices/daily_prices_YYYYMMDD.csv (per-contract settlement value = outcome ground truth; no scraping of Weather Underground needed), daily_summary for volume. Obs feed: IEM asos1min (endpoint + semantics verified in Track A for KORD). Candidate stations (settlement cities with top venue volume): KMDW (UHMDW/ULMDW), KLGA (UHLGA/ULLGA), KLAX (UHLAX/ULLAX), KSFO (UHSFO/ULSFO), KSEA (UHSEA/ULSEA), KPHX (UHPHX/ULPHX). Per-station availability is NOT yet verified, so a pre-registered inclusion guard runs FIRST and is mechanical: a station enters the study iff IEM asos1min returns >=100 obs/day on >=70% of window days (same guard family as Track A); stations failing are dropped with disclosure; <2 surviving stations kills the spec (no silent substitution of coarser feeds). Window: 2025-08-01 through 2026-07-18 (venue lake reaches 2024-08-01; 11.5 months balances seasons and bounds pulls). Early tripwire (price data only, no outcomes read): compute the distribution of first-fill-after-lock prices on the FIRST 30 window days before pulling the rest -- if median >= 98.5c the flat fee leaves no room and the spec kills early (the recon-mandated 'fee check first'). Fit/val: all lock-rule constants frozen at deployed kwx values (byte-identical shim); nothing tuned; full window is the test set. Cache under venue_expansion/cache/forecastex_study/.
specs.entry_rule: Signal: sustained_extreme/locked_orders (venue_expansion/kwx_lock_rule.py, verbatim: MARGIN_F=1.0F, sustain-3, glitch bounds) on the station's 1-min running daily max (UH contracts: YES locks when filtered max clears strike + margin) or running daily min (UL: YES locks when filtered min clears strike - margin). Monotonicity makes these permanent locks -- no bracket dead-zone. Signal uses obs only; no tape, no price, no outcome input. Entry: for each locked contract, the FIRST pairs-tape fill with pair_time >= lock timestamp; entry price = that fill's yes-side price + 1.0c pre-registered slippage penalty (labeled TRADE-TAPE PROXY: no free historical order book exists for this venue; the penalty is the conservatism substitute for a measured ask and is frozen now). No fill within 60 min of lock => fire is UNTRADEABLE, counted and disclosed, never priced off earlier/better prints. One contract per lock, hold to settlement.
specs.ev_accounting: Net EV per fire (cents/contract) = settlement payout (100 if daily_prices settlement confirms the locked side, else 0) - fill_price_cents - 1.0c slippage penalty - 1.0c fee ($0.01/contract flat, per ForecastEx_Fee_Schedule.pdf, charged at execution; settlement carries no additional per-contract fee per the schedule; the collateral 'incentive coupon' is ignored -- conservative). False-lock rate = locks whose settled outcome contradicts the locked side / all locks (this is simultaneously the WU-settlement basis-risk measurement recon flagged). Clustering unit: station-day; calendar-date clustering reported as sensitivity.
specs.min_n: >=150 lock records for the false-lock bar; >=100 priced (tradeable) lock-fires across >=50 station-day clusters and >=2 stations for the EV bar. Below either -> THIN/no-verdict.
specs.pass_bar: GO iff BOTH: (i) false locks <= 1 with Wilson upper bound at z = 2.128 (98.33% one-sided, Bonferroni 3) <= 2.5% at n >= 150; (ii) station-day-clustered t-stat of mean net EV > 0 satisfies t >= 2.25 AND mean net EV >= +0.5c/contract (i.e. edge must clearly clear the flat fee + penalty, not graze it). Symmetric KILL: one-sided 98.33% upper bound of mean net EV < +0.2c/contract => venue dead for this mechanism on fee economics, publish as such.
specs.kill_conditions: Kill if: <2 stations survive the asos1min inclusion guard; early tripwire median first-fill-after-lock price >= 98.5c on the first 30 days; fills within 60 min post-lock exist on <30% of lock station-days (tape too thin -- no executable counterparty error at measurable frequency); >4 false locks at any point (basis to WU settlement unsound -- stop pricing, publish the basis failure); or min_n unreachable within the window. Deployability flags (honest, per task): backtest feed IEM asos1min publishes 22-34h late -- LIVE signal needs MADIS (~10min) / Synoptic (~1-5min), account-gated, unverified by recon (non-negotiable #5, disclose in any GO); trading access is an ordinary IBKR brokerage account (US-legal, the only directly deployable candidate in this funnel); live order-book depth is only visible through IBKR APIs, so the 1.0c penalty proxy must be re-validated against a live book before any real order.
